root_idea.summary: The root is oriented toward sufficiency: being satisfied with something or finding it enough.
root_idea.development: From this orientation, the lexicon develops meanings of a portion or constituent part, division, substitution, and things that suffice; derived usages also include becoming divided and naming specialized components.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quran-attested noun جُزْءٌ is a distinct public lexical form.

senses.definition: A part, portion, division, constituent element, or share of a thing.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for a physical constituent portion and for an allotted share or division of a whole.

senses.definition: A portion or share of offspring, interpreted in the Quranic expression as female offspring attributed to God.
senses.usage_conditions: In 43:15, the word occurs in a polemical claim about assigning God a share from His servants; the interpretation as female offspring is a figurative and contested explanation of that expression, not a general restriction on the noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To divide a thing into parts or portions, or make it consist of parts.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive Form I usage concerning something divided or constituted in portions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take a part or portion of something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form I usage in which the subject takes a portion from an object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To curtail a poetic line by two metrical feet, or make each verse consist of two feet.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized poetic construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a thing firm, fast, or strong, or bind it firmly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct Form I usage applied to an object that is secured or strengthened.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be satisfied or content with something, or find it sufficient.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Of camels, it describes being satisfied with fresh herbage instead of water; with عَنْ followed by a wife, it can express being content to abstain from conjugal intercourse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To satisfy or suffice someone or an animal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form IV causative usage includes satisfying camels with fresh herbage so that they need no water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To serve in place of another thing or person, or make one thing suffice for another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with عَنْ to express standing in another's stead or providing an equivalent substitute.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To discharge or satisfy an obligation by having one sacrificial animal serve for another person or number of persons.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional sacrificial usage, including an animal serving in place of several persons.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of pasture or a meadow: to become luxuriant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The luxuriance is explained by the pasture's ability to satisfy grazing animals.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a woman: to give birth to female children.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form IV usage concerning the sex of offspring.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To fit an awl or knife with a handle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object furnished is an implement such as an awl or knife.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put a ring on one's finger.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic Form IV construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become divided into parts or portions.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive Form V development describing something becoming partitioned.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Fresh or green pasture or herbage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported Medinan usage attributed to one authority; the reading is disputed because another reading is commonly known in the cited report.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A volume or section of a book.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional application of the word to a division of a written work.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A metrical foot of a verse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized poetic usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A component piece used as a handle or support: specifically, the handle of an awl or knife, a vine-prop, or, in a reported dialectal usage, the rear panel of a tent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The particular object depends on the implement, plant, or dialectal context.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Relating to a part or division; partial or particular.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also substantivized for a particular or individual case.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The quality of relating to a part or particular case; particularity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An abstract noun derived from the adjective جُزْئِيٌّ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Satisfying or filling food.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of food that provides sufficient nourishment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who suffices in place of another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The active participle can describe a person who is an adequate substitute for another person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One satisfied by fresh pasture without needing water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a doe-gazelle, wild cattle, or, in the plural, palm-trees described as not needing irrigation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A strong, fat camel sufficient for the needs of its rider or carrier.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description based on the camel's ability to provide adequately for those using it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman who gives birth to female children.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized feminine participial usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Divided into parts, or having a portion taken from it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive-participial usage describing the result of partition or removal of a portion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A poetic verse curtailed by two original metrical feet, or one consisting of two feet.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical term in Arabic prosody, with the two descriptions reflecting different analyses of the curtailed form.

cautions: The explanation of جُزْءًا in 43:15 as female offspring is Quran-attested lexical commentary but is explicitly reported as a figurative and disputed interpretation.
The reported Medinan use of جَزْءٌ for fresh pasture is uncertain because the transmitted reading is disputed.
